author: Brianna Loving
title: Four kangaroos escape trailer on I-39 in Wisconsin: Two dead, one still missing - NewsBreak
text:
By Brianna Loving ,
10 hours ago
(WFRV) - All kinds of animals have been on the loose in Wisconsin, but one type that you don't see every day showed its presence on Sunday.
The Wisconsin Department of Transportation confirmed to Local 5 that the Wisconsin State Patrol responded to an incident at mile marker 85 on I-39 near Portage on August 23, around noon.
Wisconsin Sheriff: Don’t pass farm equipment in no-passing zones It was reported that four kangaroos had escaped a trailer while the owner was stopped near the interstate to transfer animals between vehicles.
Videos captured and posted to social media by various users depict footage of the kangaroos hopping their way down the interstate as traffic whizzes by.
The State Patrol officers were called to assist after two of the kangaroos were hit by vehicles on the northbound on-ramp from WIS 78 to I-39.
Neither of the struck kangaroos survived the collision.
Of the other two escaped marsupials, one was recovered and returned to its owner, and one is currently unaccounted for.
The State Patrol requests that motorists do not stop on the interstate to look for the missing animal.
Kaukauna principal will not be placed on leave following alleged misconduct, school district says If you do see the kangaroo, WisDOT encourages you to report the sighting to your local law enforcement.
No other information was provided.
